tools.name: get_latest_readout
tools.description: Get the latest daily Bitcoin cycle readout published on cycle.lombardo.life: headline and plain-English facts (price, power-law fair value, cycle phase, key levels). Read-only.

tools.name: get_fair_value
tools.description: Get Bitcoin's published power-law fair value, the price's deviation from it, and its power-law percentile zone, as shown on cycle.lombardo.life. Read-only.

tools.name: list_readouts
tools.description: List the dated daily readouts (editions) published on cycle.lombardo.life, newest first. Read-only.

tools.name: get_readout
tools.description: Get one dated daily readout published on cycle.lombardo.life (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only.
